goal_statement: Enable developers to produce and revise coherent boundary-scoped designs without disconnected prototyping or silently unresolved model inconsistencies.

success_criteria.criteria: One S5 workflow includes UI modeling/prototyping without a separate S11 category.
Actor interactions have use-case models and detailed scripts at every identified system-boundary level.
Every modeling round validates entity/boundary agreement or requests clarification, with UI limited to software boundaries.

kpis.kpi: Proposed release measure: 11/11 requirements have passing evidence.
Proposed release measure: zero false aligned results and zero UI screens on non-software boundaries.

constraints.constraint: Entities and system boundaries are the shared alignment contract.
UI screens exist only within software-type boundaries.

assumptions.assumption: Scheduling assumes one implementer; capacity and start date are unconfirmed.

open_questions.question: Implementation design in T01 must define shared references, artifact versions, and source verification.
